definitions.gloss: iron fist; hard punch; a blow with a clenched fist
definitions.explanation: Literally 'iron fist'. Refers to a powerful punch or blow with the fist. Used figuratively for forceful, authoritarian control or discipline.

examples.japanese: {鉄拳|てっけん}{制裁|せいさい}を{加|くわ}える。
その{指導者|しどうしゃ}は{鉄拳|てっけん}で{国|くに}を{治|おさ}めた。
examples.english: The leader ruled the country with an iron fist.

examples.japanese: かつては{体罰|たいばつ}として{鉄拳|てっけん}が{用|もち}いられることもあったが、今では{許容|きょよう}されない。
examples.english: In the past, physical punishment with the fist was sometimes used, but it is no longer acceptable today.

notes:
Compound of {鉄|てつ} (iron) + {拳|けん} (fist). Used both literally (a powerful punch) and figuratively (harsh, domineering control).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄拳|てっけん}{制裁|せいさい}: iron-fisted punishment; a blow as punishment
- {鉄拳|てっけん}を{振|ふ}るう: to swing an iron fist; to use force
- {鉄拳|てっけん}で{治|おさ}める: to rule with an iron fist
- {鉄拳|てっけん}{制裁|せいさい}を{食|く}らう: to receive a punch as punishment

NOTE: {鉄拳|てっけん}{制裁|せいさい} is the most common fixed compound — physical punishment as a form of discipline, now generally considered unacceptable.
